title: The 3 Levels of Harness Engineering (Beginner to Pro)
description:
Harness engineering has three levels, and most people building with AI never get past the first.

🎁 Build your own coding harness with my free course in the community: https://skool.com/leonvanzyl

🚀 Agentic Labs — exclusive AI coding courses, live Q&As, workshops & deep dives: https://skool.com/agentic-labs

Most people install Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode, add a few rules, and think that's the whole job. That's only level one of harness engineering. The real gains come when you build your own harness, or one that runs a team of agents for you. Do that and you can make small local models punch above their weight, give a whole team one consistent setup, and leave agents working for days without babysitting them.

I walk through all three levels with real examples, ending with a swarm of coding agents working in a 3D office. You'll also see how changing only the harness took one model from 6.7% to almost 70%.
